To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the most common strategy in medical image segmentation is the use of manual segmentation, which is the most accurate but the least efficient, (2) the use of interactive tools to guide the segmentation process can improve the accuracy of the segmentation, but the interaction efficiency is reduced, and (3) the use of semi-automatic segmentation tools can be more efficient than manual segmentation, but the accuracy is lower.

the most common type of interaction is to indicate the object of interest in the image; this is typically done using one or more points or a closed shape; interaction is used in different phases of segmentation; and, the main purpose of interaction is to improve the accuracy of the results.

(a) the type of information that is used by the user in an interactive segmentation method determines the type of segmentation method that is used, and (b) the type of segmentation methods that are used in an interactive segmentation determines the type of information required by the user.

the development of an interaction model to describe the use of human-computer interface in image segmentation.

the more information provided by the human operator, the more precise the segmentation results will be, but at the same time the more difficult the task of segmentation becomes for the user.

the most effective interactive segmentation method is the one that best matches the needs and the expertise of the user.

interaction is a powerful tool to improve image segmentation, but it is not a solution by itself.
